summary_en: Kadoya Sesame Mills issued a correction notice to its September 14, 2026 announcement regarding ITG-G Holdings' tender offer. The correction updates the names of three investment partnerships funding the acquirer, changing from 'Innovation Alpha Ⅴ L.P.', 'Initiative Delta Ⅴ L.P.' and 'Infinity Gamma Ⅴ L.P.' to 'IA-G3 L.P.', 'ID-G4 L.P.' and 'IG-G5 L.P.', with investment commitments of 10.655 billion yen, 13.329 billion yen and 10.653 billion yen respectively.
title_en: Notice of Correction Regarding Part of the Announcement on Expression of Opinion Supporting the Tender Offer for the Company's Shares by ITG-G Holdings Inc. and Recommendation to Subscribe
translation_en_brief: On September 16, 2026, Kadoya Sesame Mills issued a correction notice to its announcement from September 14, 2026 regarding the tender offer by ITG-G Holdings Inc. The correction relates to the names of three investment partnerships that will provide funding to the acquirer. The three entities were previously identified as 'Innovation Alpha Ⅴ L.P.', 'Initiative Delta Ⅴ L.P.' and 'Infinity Gamma Ⅴ L.P.', and have been corrected to 'IA-G3 L.P.', 'ID-G4 L.P.' and 'IG-G5 L.P.' respectively. The investment commitments from these three entities remain unchanged at 10.655 billion yen, 13.329 billion yen and 10.653 billion yen. The five funding sources for the tender offer in total are ITG-G1 投資事業有限責任組合 (2.063 billion yen), ITG-G2 投資事業有限責任組合 (32.05 billion yen), and the three corrected entities noted above.
